review.title: The algo's call
review.body:
Logged before the start, last snapshot Nov 14, 12:56 AM ET. It had Perth Glory 21%, the draw 27% and CC Mariners 52%, projecting Perth Glory 0.9 – CC Mariners 1.6 (2.5 total, CC Mariners by 0.7).

Final: Perth Glory 1 – CC Mariners 0. Wrong winner: it had CC Mariners at 52%, and Perth Glory (21%) won.

review.title: How the ratings held up
review.body:
Perth Glory came in with a 21% below average attack and a 8% stingier than average defense (2-1-1, 0.8 scored and 0.3 allowed a game over 4 games), worth about 23 and 23 games of evidence. Projected to score 0.9, they scored 1 (+0.1 goals, 10% over); projected to allow 1.6, they allowed 0 (−1.6 goals, 100% under).

CC Mariners came in with a 16% above average attack and a 7% stingier than average defense (3-1-0, 3 scored and 1 allowed a game over 4 games), worth about 24 and 23 games of evidence. Projected to score 1.6, they scored 0 (−1.6 goals, 100% under); projected to allow 0.9, they allowed 1 (+0.1 goals, 10% over).

The bigger miss was CC Mariners' scoring (-1.6 goals against projection).

review.title: Where the result sat in the simulations
review.body:
Total: 1 against 2.5 projected (-1.5), about the 19th percentile of the simulated totals (a typical game swings ±1.7).

Margin: Perth Glory by 1 against CC Mariners by 0.7 projected, about the 16th percentile of the simulated margins (typical swing ±1.7).

An ordinary result: inside the range the simulations expected most of the time.

review.body: Form (PER 2-2 L5 · CCM 3-0 L5): CC Mariners ×1.03, Perth Glory ×1.00. It favored CC Mariners, who did not beat their projection by more than the other side did.

review.title: What could have made it wrong
review.body:
Flagged going in: early-season numbers were thin; inputs were missing (PER lineup rating or past seasons, CCM lineup rating or past seasons).

The projection landed within its normal range anyway, so the flags didn't cost it much this time.

review.title: What the algo learns
review.body:
This game's own lesson: scoring came in at ×0.478 of the raw projection, and the home side beat its projected margin by -1.7 goals. It counts toward Soccer scoring level, home edge and both teams' attack and defense corrections.

Across 851 graded Soccer games the algo now scales scoring ×0.940 and gives home teams 0 goals. Team corrections so far: Perth Glory attack ×1.040, defense ×0.960 (5 games).

review.title: Bottom line
review.body: Wrong side, total within its normal range, margin within its normal range, no bet.
